test_MaxLengthCriteria: test MaxLengthCriteria to stop generation when sequence reaches a specified maximum length
test_StopStringCriteria: test StopStringCriteria to stop generation when a specific stop string is detected in output
test_StoppingCriteriaList: test StoppingCriteriaList to combine multiple stopping criteria and trigger when any one is satisfied
test_EosTokenCriteria: test EosTokenCriteria to stop generation per batch item when the EOS token is generated
test_validate_stopping_criteria: test validate_stopping_criteria to check criteria and auto-add defaults when the list is empty
